cleavage_agent: Protein samples were digested into peptides by trypsin and then analyzed on LTQ Orbitrap Velos Pro mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific).
fractionation_method: After running samples on SDS-PAGE gel, the gel for the same lane was cut into five slices.

instrument.evidence: Protein samples were digested into peptides by trypsin and then analyzed on LTQ Orbitrap Velos Pro mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific).

labeling: After mass spectrometry, raw files corresponding to five slices from the same lane were merged and analyzed via MaxQuant (v1.6.0.16) using label free quantification (LFQ).
mass_analyzer: Protein samples were digested into peptides by trypsin and then analyzed on LTQ Orbitrap Velos Pro mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific).
reduction_concentration: Nuclei were isolated from ground frozen sample powder using HONDA buffer (20 mM Hepes KOH pH 7.4, 10 mM MgCl2, 440 mM sucrose, 1.25% Ficoll, 2.5% Dextran T40, 0.5% Triton X-100, 5 mM DTT, 5 mM phenylmethylsulfonyl fluoride [PMSF] and 1% Protease Inhibitor Cocktail [Sigma-Aldrich]).
reduction_reagent: Nuclei were isolated from ground frozen sample powder using HONDA buffer (20 mM Hepes KOH pH 7.4, 10 mM MgCl2, 440 mM sucrose, 1.25% Ficoll, 2.5% Dextran T40, 0.5% Triton X-100, 5 mM DTT, 5 mM phenylmethylsulfonyl fluoride [PMSF] and 1% Protease Inhibitor Cocktail [Sigma-Aldrich]).
